video_title: Steve Kerr provides update on Steph Curry’s oblique injury | NBC Sports Bay Area

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's recovery progress following his oblique injury
quotes.excerpt: He's in the gym every day and he's been with us and Rick's in there with him
quotes.quote: He's showing great. He's in the gym every day and he's been with us and Rick's in there with him and making really good strides. So everything's on schedule.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr says Steph Curry is making good strides in his recovery from an oblique injury and everything is on schedule for his return.

structured.context: Steve Kerr provides an update on Stephen Curry's recovery progress from an oblique injury during a media availability.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Malone's impact on the Portland Trail Blazers' performance
quotes.excerpt: He's well regarded all over the league. Did a great job with Minnesota, Chris Finch
quotes.quote: He's got a lot of experience in the league. He's well regarded all over the league. Did a great job with Minnesota, Chris Finch, who's a great coach himself. He was able to take over for Chris when Chris was out and they didn't skip a beat. Around the league everybody knew Michael would be a good coach when he got his chance.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr praises Michael Malone for his experience and reputation around the league, noting that everyone knew he would be a good coach when he got his chance.

structured.context: Steve Kerr discusses the coaching abilities of Michael Malone and Chris Finch.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Changes in team offensive concepts and player roles
quotes.excerpt: We tweaked a few things since we decided to start Draymond and Charles together
quotes.quote: We tweaked a few things since we decided to start Draymond and Charles together. Coming off that road trip, we knew we had to make some adjustments. Playing without Steph is always a big adjustment, but we had to try to help our guys. We made a few changes and the last couple games you're starting to see a little better flow, a little better rhythm offensively.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr says the Warriors made offensive adjustments after starting Draymond Green and Charles together, noting the team is starting to see better flow and rhythm.

structured.context: Steve Kerr explains the recent offensive adjustments made to the team's rotation and strategy.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive challenges presented by Dennis Ogbe's playing style
quotes.excerpt: He is number one in the league in drives. He's just downhill, downhill, downhill
quotes.quote: He is number one in the league in drives. He's just downhill, downhill, downhill. He goes right and even when you know he's going right, he gets right. Even when he knows that you know he's going right, he still gets right. He's got a knack for drawing fouls. He's learned the tricks of the trade. You have to be really vigilant as a team to cut off his transition driving lanes and to show your hands.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr on defending Dennis Ogbe: He is downhill constantly and even when you know he is going right, he gets right. He has a knack for drawing fouls.

structured.context: Steve Kerr describes the defensive challenges posed by Dennis Ogbe's aggressive driving style.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's versatility and value to the team
quotes.excerpt: He's the ultimate Swiss Army knife. He can guard anybody
quotes.quote: He's the ultimate Swiss Army knife. He can guard anybody. You can put him on a big guy and he's so strong that he's not going to get overpowered on the block, but he guards equally as well on ball, off ball. He's a ball handler but he's very comfortable just playing in the corner and shooting threes and his temperament is incredible. He's just an amazing teammate.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr calls Draymond Green the ultimate Swiss Army knife, praising his ability to guard anyone and his incredible temperament as a teammate.

structured.context: Steve Kerr praises the versatility and value of Draymond Green to the team.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Sean Kemp's Hall of Fame candidacy and playing legacy
quotes.excerpt: I always loved Sean, a great teammate, a really good guy
quotes.quote: I always loved Sean, a great teammate, a really good guy. He was just a freak of nature in his glory days in Seattle and just so hard to account for at both ends. So yeah, I hope he gets in, just an incredible player and a great teammate.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr says he hopes Sean Kemp gets into the Hall of Fame, calling him a freak of nature in his glory days and an incredible player.

structured.context: Steve Kerr shares his thoughts on Shawn Kemp's legacy and Hall of Fame candidacy.
